title: Neurosity Crown Focus Focus Score Leaderboard
dataSources: HRV (`hrv:reading`), blood oxygen (`spo2:reading`), lab panels (`bloodpanel:result`), supplements (`supplement:intake`), continuous glucose (`cgm:glucose`), sleep-apnea events (`apnea:event`), body composition (`bodycomp:measure`), blood pressure (`bloodpressure:reading`).
app: Biohacking data — HRV straps, pulse oximeters, blood-pressure cuffs, continuous glucose monitors, body-composition scales, lab-result exports, and supplement logs — ingested to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=neurosity:focus focus_score=*
| stats sum(focus_score) as total_value, avg(focus_score) as avg_value by session_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks session type values by total and average focus score across Neurosity Crown focus events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `focus_score` values for each Neurosity Crown focus event and review total and average focus score by session type.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total focus score.
grandmaExplanation: It clearly which session type shows the biggest focus score numbers in your Neurosity Crown focus data.
